high_score_vocabulary.source_sentence: More and more people try to discover various destinations.
high_score_vocabulary.minimal_sentence: More and more people try to explore various destinations.
high_score_vocabulary.example_sentence: Travellers can explore coastal towns and learn about local food traditions.
high_score_vocabulary.reason: The writer means visiting and learning about places, rather than finding unknown destinations. Explore expresses active engagement more precisely.
high_score_vocabulary.source_sentence_zh: 越来越多的人尝试发现各种目的地。
high_score_vocabulary.minimal_sentence_zh: 越来越多的人尝试探索各种目的地。
high_score_vocabulary.example_sentence_zh: 旅行者可以探索沿海城镇，了解当地饮食传统。
high_score_vocabulary.reason_zh: 原句指主动游览和了解地点，explore 比强调发现未知事物的 discover 更精准。

items.example_sentence: Travellers visit various destinations to learn about local cultures.
items.example_sentence_zh: 旅行者前往各种目的地，了解当地文化。
